title: The limits of the role: when the answer is "I cannot do that"

videos.script: A lot of what support is asked to do, it should do. Some of it, it should not: make someone an administrator of their own computer, install a program nobody approved, switch off the antivirus because the computer is slow. {{asks}} Some of those limits are set in the computer: the account simply cannot. Others are set only by the organisation's rules, and the account could do it perfectly well. {{two}} This lesson shows a help desk account running into the first kind, and what the computer writes down when it does. {{lab}} Then it goes through the second kind, which is harder, and how to say no in a way that still helps the person who asked. {{help}}
